NL-PASSPORT-ID-VISIBLE-NUMBER-PRE-2019.description: Dutch passport/ID document number — 2014 model issued before 1 Dec 2019. 9 chars, pos 1-2 letters, no O. Digit 0 allowed.

NL-PASSPORT-ID-VISIBLE-NUMBER-POST-2019.description: Dutch passport/ID document number — 2014 from 1 Dec 2019, 2021 ID card, 2021/2024 passport. 9 chars, pos 1-2 letters, no O, no 0 anywhere, pos 9 digit 1-9.

NL-BSN-VISIBLE-DOCUMENT-11PROEF.description: Dutch BSN. 9 digits, weights [9,8,7,6,5,4,3,2,-1], sum mod 11 == 0, sum > 0.

ICAO-MRZ-TD3.description: ICAO TD3 (passport) — 2 lines × 44 chars. Per-field check digits + composite check digit.

ICAO-MRZ-TD1.description: ICAO TD1 (ID card) — 3 lines × 30 chars. Per-field check digits + composite check digit.
